title: The Pilgrim Road
text: The road is lined with little shrines, each with a candle burning in a niche, each to someone who did not finish this journey. There are hundreds. The newest has no name on it yet, and its candle is unlit.

options.label: Light a candle at every shrine.

outcomes.text: It takes all day. The road feels lighter after, and the unlit one is lit.

options.label: The most devout prays at the newest shrine.

outcomes.text: The candles go out as you pass, one by one, all the way down the road.
